title: Zesty Sour Greek Feta Tiropita
description: A sour and savory Greek dish featuring tamarind paste, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a raclette grill and encased in a flaky crust, tiropita style, that is also suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the crumbly feta cheese, tamarind paste, chopped parsley, chopped scallions, salt, and black pepper.
Unroll the thawed filo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Brush each piece of filo dough with olive oil and place a quarter of the feta mixture in the center of each piece.
Fold the filo dough over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal the tiropita.
Place the tiropitas in the raclette grill and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tiropitas from the grill and brush with lemon juice.
Serve the tiropitas hot and enjoy.
